objective: Measure how Physical Halation edge-replicated box diffusion changes halo peak, footprint, and spatial distribution when highlights approach or touch the image frame boundary.

scope.effect: PhysicalHalation source-equation highlight extraction and dual-layer box diffusion; focus is frame-edge boundary sampling.
scope.method: Offline Float32 equation model on 256x256 opaque-black plates with one neutral HDR highlight pixel at center, frame edges, corners, and controlled pixel distances from each edge. Evaluate spread 15 and 50 (red radii 30/100px, GB radii 15/50px), default threshold .8, softness .5, redDiffusion2, intensity.5.
excluded: alpha transparency edge (source alpha remains opaque)

comparison.baseline: Same source point with effect disabled; zero delta reference.
candidates: center point at least red radius from boundary
source point at distance 0,1,radius-1,radius,radius+1 from one frame edge
points on opposite edge and corners for symmetry
comparison.ground_truth: None. The source equation and equal-energy translated point field are descriptive mathematical references, not an approved visual target.
comparison.acceptance: No quality pass/fail. Verify source markers, zero response outside support, alpha identity, finite field and nonnegative diffusion. Report energy, peak, centroid, footprint and border-band fractions. Do not infer product defect or optical-film realism.

materials.fixture: Synthetic opaque black Float32 BGRA frame; one neutral source pixel with B=G=R=4 and alpha=1. Other pixels are zero RGB and alpha=1.
materials.identity: Record source/plan/runner hashes, each source coordinate and output arrays/metrics.

regions.center_profile: horizontal and vertical lines through source coordinate

conditions.source_positions: For each spread: centered impulse (128,128); horizontal and vertical single-edge impulses at distances 0,1,r-1,r,r+1,2r+1 where r=spread; opposite-edge symmetric cases; and four corners. Coordinates are clipped to valid frame bounds; duplicate positions are emitted once.
conditions.numeric_domain: Float32 direct numeric values, no output clamp or transfer conversion. Alpha is opaque 1 everywhere.
conditions.equation: Rec.601 source luma and soft-knee highlight weight from Halation. Build highlight channels (B*.1,G*.2,R); apply one horizontal and one vertical edge-replicated box pass (not two passes on the same axis) at radius=int(spread*2) to red and int(spread) to green/blue; preserve source alpha. Analyze pre-intensity diffusion fields and intensity=.5 additive delta separately.
conditions.regions_and_rois: Whole-frame channel fields; frame-border bands at fixed pixel widths; horizontal/vertical center profiles and impulse-centered crop.
metrics: per-layer sum/energy and interior-relative conservation ratio
centroid offset from source in pixels
position symmetry between opposing frame edges
conditions.display: Common-gain amplified diffusion contact sheets at 1:1 and enlarged crops; raw Float32 metrics are authoritative.

effect_correctness.method: Verify edge-clamp box passes, red/GB radii, zero source and alpha invariants.
effect_correctness.acceptance_criteria: Model matches declared equations; no compiled parity claim.

image_quality_and_detail.method: Inspect center, edge and corner impulse profiles and contact sheets.
image_quality_and_detail.acceptance_criteria: No aesthetic or physical realism judgment.

color_and_alpha.method: Analyze channel response for neutral HDR impulse and exact opaque alpha.
color_and_alpha.unverified: Transparent alpha boundaries, colored sources and downstream compositing.

evaluation.decision: No defect classification, quality acceptance or implementation approval.

execution.backend: Python NumPy offline source-equation model; no UI, app, build or test execution.
execution.reproducibility: Fixed frame, point coordinates, sizes, source equations and hashes.

amendments.reason: Initial exploratory runner applied two sequential box passes within each 1D profile, while the source applies one horizontal and one vertical pass. The runner was corrected to use a single 1D pass per axis; all result metrics and contact sheets were regenerated before interpretation.
amendments.effect: Corrected source-equation model; no scope or acceptance change.
